```python
import hashlib, struct, sys

from wire import packet, payload as wire_payload, seal, NAMES

MASK=(1<<24)-1

def ipv4_csum_ok(hdr):
    s=0
    for i in range(10): s += (hdr[2*i]<<8)|hdr[2*i+1]
    while s>>16: s=(s&0xffff)+(s>>16)
    return s==0xffff

def icrc_ok(frame):
    import zlib
    iplen = (frame[16]<<8)|frame[17]
    if len(frame) != iplen+14: return False
    body = bytearray(b'\xff'*8 + frame[14:len(frame)-4])
    body[9]=255; body[16]=255; body[18:20]=b'\xff\xff'; body[34:36]=b'\xff\xff'; body[40]=255
    stored = struct.unpack('<I', frame[-4:])[0]
    return zlib.crc32(bytes(body)) == stored

def wire_valid(frame, D):
    if len(frame) < 58: return None
    if frame[12:14] != b'\x08\x00': return None
    ip = frame[14:]
    if ip[0] != 0x45: return None
    iplen = (ip[2]<<8)|ip[3]
    if iplen+14 != len(frame): return None
    if ip[9] != 17: return None
    frag = (ip[6]<<8)|ip[7]
    if frag not in (0,0x4000): return None
    if not ipv4_csum_ok(bytes(ip[:20])): return None
    udp = ip[20:]
    udplen = (udp[4]<<8)|udp[5]
    if udplen+20 != iplen: return None
    if udplen < 8+12+4: return None
    if (udp[0]<<8|udp[1]) != 4791 or (udp[2]<<8|udp[3]) != 4791: return None
    if (udp[6]<<8|udp[7]) != 0: return None
    bth = udp[8:]
    op = bth[0]
    if op not in (4,0x11): return None
    if bth[1] != 0: return None
    if (bth[2]<<8|bth[3]) != 0xffff: return None
    qpn = struct.unpack('!I', bth[4:8])[0]
    if qpn & 0xff000000: return None
    apsn = struct.unpack('!I', bth[8:12])[0]
    top = apsn>>24
    if (op==4 and top!=0x80) or (op==0x11 and top!=0): return None
    bodylen = udplen-8-12-4
    psn = apsn & MASK
    if op==0x11:
        if bodylen != 4: return None
        aeth = bth[12:16]
        if aeth[0] != 0x1f: return None
        low = (aeth[1]<<16)|(aeth[2]<<8)|aeth[3]
        if low != (psn+1)&MASK: return None
        if not icrc_ok(frame): return None
        return ('ack', psn, qpn, None)
    else:
        if bodylen != 4*D: return None
        if not icrc_ok(frame): return None
        return ('data', psn, qpn, bytes(bth[12:12+bodylen]))
```
